scope: Serial C++ commercial electrical-node golden authority; not a hardware ABI or distributed shadow protocol

identity.node: u32 native electrical-node ID from the independently audited complete graph
identity.net: u32 physical-net ID from the frozen full DCP footprint
identity.pip: u32 key=(native_PIP_id<<1)|direction; exact parallel PIP identity retained

state.tree: One source and sparse node -> (parent, PIP key, source depth) map per net
state.resource: Sparse node -> distinct net set, u64 history, u64 version
state.retained_empty_records: Rip-up retains resource history/version, including zero-owner records
state.sharing: All sinks of one net share a single tree; same-net prefix uses a node once
state.sources: Source nodes remain owned during rip-up and are included in occupancy

cost.new_node: 1 + history(node) + present * count(other nets using node)
cost.lower_bound: Consistent quotient hop distance is valid because each newly used edge costs at least one

updates.accept: Validate complete branch, permissions, exact PIPs, attachment, no tree reentry, depth and version ranges before publication; stage all allocating structures first
updates.ripup: Release each non-root tree node once; preserve other net owners and history; precheck all ownership/version conditions
updates.negotiate: All owners of overused nodes are scheduled; history increases by increment*(distinct owners-1); check all overflows before mutation
updates.version: Increment on source acquisition, each new branch-node acquisition, rip-up and nonzero history update; never wrap
updates.limitations: In-process checked-error atomicity; not crash durability or native speculative transaction validation

cohort.selection: Take first N tasks per ordered source/sink SLR pair, then include every task of each selected net
cohort.outside_ownership: Freeze original electrical-node footprint of every unselected net, including unselected candidate nets
cohort.static_policy: Also honor background/partition/clock/access protections and exclusive terminal/access ownership
cohort.ordering: Nets ordered by first original task ID; connections retain original task order
cohort.deferred_retry: Retry failed sinks only when the same net tree has grown; preserve the label cap and count all extra searches
cohort.closure: Every selected sink reachable from its original source, exact distinct-net occupancy and zero final overused nodes
cohort.native_legality: Must separately write DCP and run native tool checks; electrical model convergence alone is insufficient
